planets.name: TOI-7265 B b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-7265 B with a 4.17-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-7265 B b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-7265 B. Its orbit and size follow Premnath et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname PREMNATH_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2026, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.17232, pl_radj 0.95, pl_bmassj 0.71
